title: Lesson 3. Mouse pro
description: Right click, dragging and the scroll wheel

questions.prompt: Match the mouse part with what it does
questions.explain: Left — yes, right — menu, wheel — lift.

questions.prompt: How do you move an icon somewhere else?
The right-click menu is always the same.
questions.explain: The menu differs because things differ.

questions.prompt: How do you close a menu you don't need?
questions.explain: Clicking an empty spot closes the menu.

questions.prompt: Put the dragging steps in order

questions.text: To scroll a page up and down we turn the ___.

questions.prompt: In "Sort into corners", where do animals go?
questions.explain: Food — top left, vehicles — top right, animals — bottom left, toys — bottom right.

questions.prompt: You can delete a practice folder like this: right-click → "Delete".
questions.explain: The folder goes to the bin.

learn.intro: The mouse has secrets! Today you become a real mouse pro.

slides.text: The **left button** means "yes, select". The **right button** asks "what can I do?" — it opens a menu.
Right-click the desktop, an icon, the taskbar — the menu is different each time because the things are different. Click an empty spot — the menu closes.

check.prompt: What does the right mouse button do?
check.explain: The right button asks: "What can I do?"

slides.text: To move an icon: press **the left button and hold it**. Hold — and move the mouse. Let go — the icon stays there.
The "Sort into corners" game: food to the top left, vehicles to the top right, animals to the bottom left, toys to the bottom right. Against the clock!

check.prompt: To drag an icon you hold the left button while moving the mouse.

slides.text: The **wheel** is like a lift: it moves the page up and down.
Open a long story and turn the wheel — the text moves up and down.

check.prompt: What is the mouse wheel like?
check.explain: It moves the page up and down like a lift.
